content.title: Is Bill Murray rooting for UConn in March Madness?
content.text: NCAABIs Bill Murray rooting for UConn in March Madness?Wajih AlBaroudiFor The WinMarch 20, 2026, 2:02 p.m. ETKeep WatchingBill Murray is a hard person to track down.The legendary actor famously does not have an agent nor a publicist, so he uses a 1-800 number and voicemail system to hear from friends and colleagues.So, if you don't have that number, the next best spot to meet Murray might be a UConn men's basketball game. Why, you may ask? You've come to the right place.Is Bill Murray a UConn fan?By association, yes!Murray's son, Luke Murray, has been an assistant coach under Dan Hurley since 2021, winning consecutive championships in 2023 and '24. Bill, 75, has regularly attended games during that time and even celebrated on court with the Huskies' after their national title wins.So, it would not be surprising at all to see Bill cheering on the Huskies as March Madness continues.
